# Claude for Microsoft 365 — "Office agents" — FIRST CAPTURE 2026-08-27
# Source set: https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/{excel,powerpoint,word,outlook,
#                work-across-apps,connectors-and-skills,third-party-platforms,data-storage}
# NOT IN sources.json. Never read by this monitor before today.
# Surfaced because the 2026-08-26 Anthropic release note added product_surface
# `office_agents/*` to the Compliance API. The PRODUCT is not new — Excel/PowerPoint/Word
# went GA 2026-05-07, Outlook is in public beta — this monitor simply never covered it.
# Note the support.claude.com article 301-redirects to claude.com/docs/office-agents/*.

## WHAT IT IS
Four Office add-ins (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) installed from Microsoft AppSource
as a single listing, "Claude for Microsoft 365" (WA200010725). Sidebar task pane, sharing
ONE conversation thread per M365 user across all four apps.
Plans: Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise. Requires SharedRuntime (so: NOT iPad, NOT Android,
NOT Excel 2016/2019 perpetual/volume).

## PER-APP CAPABILITY (all WRITE, not just read)
Excel   : read/answer with CELL-LEVEL CITATIONS; change values preserving formula
          relationships; debug #REF!/#DIV/0; generate models; populate templates;
          multi-tab; native ops — sort, filter, EDIT PIVOT TABLES, conditional
          formatting, data-validation dropdowns. NOT supported: data tables, macros/VBA.
PowerPoint: build slides in template, edit selection, generate native charts/diagrams,
          respects slide masters.
Word    : edit with TRACKED CHANGES, respond to COMMENT THREADS, preserve company styles
          and heading hierarchy.
Outlook (beta): inbox triage, draft replies, coordinate CALENDAR AVAILABILITY across team
          members. Reaches `graph.microsoft.com` MAILBOX AND CALENDAR API via Microsoft
          Entra ID Nested App Auth (`login.microsoftonline.com`) for the Graph token.

## CROSS-APP MODE ("Let Claude work across files")
*** DEFAULT-ON for Pro and Max. Default-OFF for Team and Enterprise. PER-DEVICE toggle. ***
Runs over a WebSocket bridge at `bridge.claudeusercontent.com`.
Admin control: Organization settings > Office agents > "Let Claude work across apps".
NOT supported when connecting through Bedrock / Vertex AI / Foundry / an LLM gateway
 => cross-app only works on DIRECT Claude accounts. In a tenant that routes AI through
    Bedrock, any cross-app usage is by definition out-of-band personal-account usage.
Limits: only files/emails CURRENTLY OPEN; Claude cannot create, open, close or switch files.

## CONNECTORS AND SKILLS
Connectors: `+` below the chat input > Connectors. Named: S&P Global, LSEG, Daloopa
(financial data) "plus any custom connectors your organization has enabled".
CUSTOM CONNECTORS ARE REMOTE MCP. Anthropic's own warning: "Custom connectors can
introduce security risks."  MCP tool calls proxy through `mcp-proxy.anthropic.com`.
`api.anthropic.com` serves "Claude inference API, file uploads, CODE-EXECUTION CONTAINERS,
and MCP CONNECTOR REGISTRY".
Skills: enabled in Claude settings, apply automatically; invoke directly with `/` (e.g.
`/deck-check` in PowerPoint). App-irrelevant skills are filtered out of the list.
Skills download over `pivot.claude.ai`.
Persistent Instructions: per-app, set in the add-in sidebar Settings, applied to EVERY
conversation in that app. Excel Instructions are separate from PowerPoint/Word.

## ANTHROPIC'S OWN PROMPT-INJECTION WARNING (verbatim, on the Excel page)
"Only use Claude for Excel with trusted spreadsheets. Files from external sources can
 contain hidden instructions that manipulate the add-in into extracting data, modifying
 records, or performing destructive actions."
"Testing has identified scenarios where Claude for Excel can be manipulated to extract
 sensitive information, modify critical data, or perform destructive actions if allowed
 to act without verification."
Mitigation is a per-operation user confirmation prompt — i.e. user click-through.

## DATA HANDLING / LOGGING — THE COVERAGE PROBLEM
Chat history is stored LOCALLY in the browser via IndexedDB. "Conversations are not stored
on Anthropic's servers, are not synced across devices, and can be cleared from Settings."
Reinstalling the add-in or switching between Claude add-ins does NOT remove it.
Backend inputs/outputs deleted within 30 days; cached for some hours after deletion.
*** The add-ins DO NOT inherit the org's custom data retention settings. ***
*** The docs still state: "Activity is not included in Enterprise audit logs or the
    Compliance API." — CONTRADICTED by the 2026-08-26 release note, which added
    office_agents/* to the Compliance API local session endpoints in beta.
    The product docs are STALE relative to the platform release notes. Re-verify. ***

## THIRD-PARTY PLATFORM DEPLOYMENT (docs/office-agents/third-party-platforms)
Four connection paths, chosen by IT admin; end users see an identical interface:
  LLM gateway      — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong etc. "Matches the pattern used by Claude Code."
  Bedrock direct   — add-in authenticates via Microsoft Entra ID, calls Bedrock directly.
  Vertex AI direct — Google OAuth, calls Vertex directly.
  Foundry direct   — per-user Entra token (KEYLESS) or the resource API key. Deployment
                     names must be default model IDs (e.g. `claude-opus-4-6`), not custom.
                     Keyless needs an Entra app registration with Azure Cognitive Services
                     `user_impersonation` delegated permission (admin-consented) + users
                     holding the Cognitive Services User role.
Bedrock direct REQUIRES: an IAM OIDC identity provider trusting Microsoft Entra ID tokens,
and a role with `bedrock:InvokeModel` + `bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream`, trust
policy scoped to the Claude add-in's application ID.
 => A STANDING ENTRA -> AWS FEDERATION EDGE created for an Office add-in.

## DEPLOYMENT IS DRIVEN BY A CLAUDE CODE PLUGIN
  claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/financial-services
  claude plugin install claude-for-msft-365-install@claude-for-financial-services
  /claude-for-msft-365-install:setup
Commands:
  :setup              provisions cloud resources, admin consent, writes manifest
  :manifest           generates customized add-in manifest XML
  :consent            generates the Azure admin-consent URL
  :update-user-attrs  *** writes PER-USER configuration via MICROSOFT GRAPH EXTENSION
                          ATTRIBUTES *** (e.g. different gateway tokens or AWS roles per team)
  :bootstrap          *** builds a BOOTSTRAP ENDPOINT for PER-USER MCP SERVERS, SKILLS and
                          DYNAMIC CONFIG *** — an org-controlled channel that pushes MCP
                          servers and skills to individual users at runtime
  :debug              triage
  :export-data        read-only copy of a user's chat history, skills, CONNECTOR
                      REGISTRATIONS and settings
Custom-manifest path for tenants with the Office Store disabled:
  https://pivot.claude.ai/manifest-excel.xml  (per-app manifests)

## NETWORK ALLOWLIST (both modes route UI + telemetry to Anthropic even in 3P mode)
1P: pivot.claude.ai, claude.ai, api.anthropic.com, appsforoffice.microsoft.com,
    login.microsoftonline.com (Outlook), o1158394.ingest.us.sentry.io (optional),
    mcp-proxy.anthropic.com (MCP), bridge.claudeusercontent.com (cross-app),
    graph.microsoft.com (Outlook)
3P: pivot.claude.ai, claude.ai/api/, appsforoffice.microsoft.com, login.microsoftonline.com,
    sentry, + the chosen inference endpoint (gateway URL / sts.amazonaws.com +
    bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com / accounts.google.com + oauth2.googleapis.com +
    aiplatform.googleapis.com / <resource>.services.ai.azure.com), graph.microsoft.com
Anthropic's note: "Domains pointing to Anthropic (such as pivot.claude.ai) serve the
add-in's interface, feature configuration, and operational telemetry, not prompt or
response content."

## ADMIN DEPLOYMENT (1P)
M365 Admin Center > Settings > Org Settings > User owned apps and services >
"Let users access the Office Store"; then Settings > Integrated apps > Add-ins > assign.
Known Microsoft issue: the Integrated apps page does NOT recognise roles activated through
Entra PIM, so deployment fails (tracking ID 11126536) — workaround is a PERMANENTLY ACTIVE
admin role rather than PIM-eligible. Individual users can ALWAYS self-install regardless.

## MODEL ACCESS
"A curated subset of the Claude models". Org model-access settings apply in 1P mode.
In 3P mode the model list comes from the PLATFORM and the admin's configuration instead,
NOT from Claude.ai model access settings.
